 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026 , 30th Match (Eliminator) - Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Chitwan Rhinos , to be played on the 18th of November at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Kathmandu Gorkhas v Chitwan Rhinos 
 30th Match (Eliminator) - Kathmandu Gorkhas vs Chitwan Rhinos (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137

 Current Form Kathmandu Gorkhas:
 Kathmandu Gorkhas finished at the 3rd position on points table after league stages and they will now face Chitwan Rhinos in the Eliminator Match. 
 The top run scorer for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Rashid Khan with 186 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Jahandad Khan with 12 scalps under his belt. 
 Kathmandu Gorkhas have lost their previous match against Pokhara Avengers by a big margin of 55 runs.
 Pokhara Avengers batted first and they posted a massive total of 224 for 3 in 20 overs. Arjun Kumal got out without troubling the scorers much. After his dismissal, Yuvraj Samra and Kushal Bhurtel played like champions. Samra made 89 while Bhurtel scored 99 runs in only 51 deliveries, hitting 8 fours and 8 sixes. On the back of such sizzling knocks with the bat, Pokhara Avengers managed to reach a big total of 224 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Kathmandu Gorkhas couldn't get off to an ideal start. They lost 2 early wickets and looked quite detailed during the run chase. There were tiny contributions in the middle order by Rashid Khan and Jahandad Khan but none of them were significant enough to take Kathmandu Gorkhas closer to the target. Dinesh Kharel bowled beautifully. He picked up 4 wickets for just 18 runs in his spell to help bowl Kathmandu Gorkhas out for 169, as Pokhara Avengers won the game by 55 runs.
 Current Form Chitwan Rhinos:
 Chitwan Rhinos finished at the 4th position on points table after league stages and they will now face Kathmandu Gorkhas in the Eliminator Match. 
 The top run scorer for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Dawid Malan with 149 runs to his name. 
 The top wicket taker for Chitwan Rhinos in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kamal Singh Airee with 12 scalps under his belt. 
 Chitwan Rhinos have lost their previous match against Karnali Yaks by 24 runs.
 Karnali Yaks batted first and they posted a total of 153 for 8 in 20 overs. Sachin Sharma, Deepak Dumre and David Miller all got out without troubling the scorers much. Ariful Islam and Hussain Talat then revived the innings. Islam scored 35 off 15 balls while Talat went on to make 51 runs in 33 balls. Talat stayed not out and helped Karnali Yaks reach a competitive total of 153 on a tough surface to bat on.
 During the chase, Kamil Mishara and Dev Khanal gave a stunning start to Chitwan Rhinos. They added 35 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Once the first wicket fell though, the innings started detailing. Batters started gifting their wicket away one by one and Chitwan Rhinos looked in all sorts of bother. Usama Mir fought hard and scored 28 runs but he didn't find any significant support in other batters and Chitwan Rhinos were eventually bowled out for 129, losing the match by 24 runs.
